description: This script retrieves version information from a version file or version control systems (Git or Mercurial). It determines the current revision by checking the 'version' file or querying the version control system (git or hg), and outputs the revision string.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks if a 'version' file exists and reads its contents to get the revision.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Attempts to determine the current revision via Git commands, supporting branch and revision shorthand.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Attempts to determine the current revision via Mercurial commands.
